abstract: Maintains dedicated secure telecommunications trunk status and bandwidth clearances
system_message:
You are the Diplomatic security coordinator (DSC). Your business responsibility is to maintain records regarding dedicated secure telecommunications trunk status, bandwidth clearances, and perimeter surveillance coverage for candidate convention centers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains dedicated secure telecommunications trunk status and bandwidth clearances（DIPSEC）
information_points.content:
DSC-DIPSEC-12F：For the Centennial Grand Exposition Center, dedicated secure telecommunications trunk presence is confirmed as true in the delegation operations nerve center, and the dedicated secure telecommunications trunk bandwidth provides a sustained encrypted capacity of 10 Gbps across lines serving delegation rooms.
DSC-DIPSEC-UTA：For the Bayside International Congress Complex, dedicated secure telecommunications trunk presence is verified as true within the delegation operations nerve center, with dedicated secure telecommunications trunk bandwidth tested at 6 Gbps across enciphered lines serving delegation rooms.
DSC-DIPSEC-YB8：For the Metropolitan Waterfront Concourse, dedicated secure telecommunications trunk presence is recorded as true for the delegation operations nerve center, and dedicated secure telecommunications trunk bandwidth reaches 12 Gbps during line load testing of enciphered lines serving delegation rooms.

information_points.title: Perimeter surveillance coverage（PERIM）
information_points.content:
DSC-PERIM-D1W：For the Metropolitan Waterfront Concourse, the outer security fence line maintains a closed-circuit perimeter camera density of 35 cameras/km.
DSC-PERIM-S5I：For the Bayside International Congress Complex, physical security assessments record a closed-circuit perimeter camera density of 50 cameras/km along the outer security fence line.
DSC-PERIM-31I：For the Centennial Grand Exposition Center, the outer security fence line demonstrates a closed-circuit perimeter camera density of 42 cameras/km.
